They change function and move after other control-positioning operations. However they form one adjacent two-statement extracted sequence; neither moves independently of the other. Under the strict rule excluding carried components of edited extraction parents, these are two coverage endpoints of one extraction event, not two independent events. Coordinator must apply the same extraction policy as OpenCV ordinary-04 before counting.
